origen.heading: Born in a blooming desert
lines: Between the Pacific Ocean and the Andes lies a desert that, with water and patience, became an orchard.
That is where we started over a decade ago, with a few hectares and a simple idea: care for the fruit from the seed.
Constant sun, cool nights and Andean water give it flavour, colour and a longer shelf life.
Today we work alongside families on the northern and southern coast to bring that flavour to tables around the world.
origen.imageAlt: Green farmland in the middle of the Peruvian coastal desert
origen.mapText: Our farms sit in the coastal valleys, where the climate allows harvests almost all year round.
origen.mapLabel: Map of Peru showing the growing regions

proceso.heading: How our fruit travels
proceso.intro: Five stages, the same care. We control every step so the fruit arrives just as it left the field.

siembra.title: Planting
siembra.text: We choose varieties suited to the coastal climate and use drip irrigation to use only the water needed.
siembra.alt: Young seedlings lined up in the field

cosecha.title: Harvest
cosecha.text: We hand-pick at the right ripeness, during the coolest hours of the day.

empaque.title: Packing
empaque.text: At the packhouse we grade by size and quality and pack to each customer's format.

frio.title: Cold chain
frio.text: Fruit goes into pre-cooling tunnels and stays temperature-controlled all the way to port.

envio.title: Shipping
envio.text: We ship in reefer containers by sea or air, with end-to-end traceability.
